1	# YAML Frontmatter Schema
2	
3	`schema.yaml` in this directory is the canonical contract for `docs/solutions/` frontmatter written by `spec-compound`.
4	
5	Use this file as the quick reference for:
6	- required fields
7	- enum values
8	- validation expectations
9	- category mapping
10	- track classification (bug vs knowledge)
11	
12	## Classification Contract v2
13	
14	Use closed responsibility-based enums for new learnings. Select the owning boundary, not the host name or a concrete class; put the precise project/module name in `module` and searchable details in `tags`. Scripts check mechanical facts; classification remains an evidence-grounded author judgment.
15	
16	| Component | Owning responsibility |
17	| --- | --- |
18	| `cli` | Commands, argument handling, user-facing CLI output |
19	| `workflow` | Spec, plan, tasks, work, review and their handoffs |
20	| `skill` | Skill instructions and local prompt assets |
21	| `runtime` | Host projection, initialization and source/runtime synchronization |
22	| `provider` | External tool adapters and readiness facts |
23	| `contract` | Artifact schemas and producer/consumer agreements |
24	| `verification` | Evidence admission, checks and completion claims |
25	| `knowledge` | Learning capture, retrieval and vocabulary |
26	| `governance` | Authority, ownership and project rules |
27	| `application_code` | User-project domain/application implementation |
28	| `development_workflow` | Cross-cutting engineering practices |
29	| `testing_framework` | Test and evaluation infrastructure |
30	| `documentation` | Documentation content and discoverability |
31	| `tooling` | Supporting scripts not owned by a more specific boundary |
32	
33	For example, a projection copying obsolete assets is `runtime` / `source_runtime_drift`; a consumer reading an incompatible artifact is `contract` / `contract_drift`; an agent asserting behavior from old session notes is `knowledge` / `stale_context`. Choose the demonstrated cause, not merely the affected area.
34	
35	Untouched existing docs keep their path and remain readable, including legacy component/root-cause values and `rails_version`. New docs use v2. Every material rewrite re-evaluates all classification fields against current evidence and uses v2 enums, while preserving the path and unrelated metadata and adding promotion fields. Do not mechanically map every legacy term or migrate unrelated docs. In particular, a class named `assistant` does not establish a workflow owner.
36	
37	## Tracks
38	
39	The `problem_type` determines which **track** applies. Each track has different required and optional fields.
40	
41	| Track | problem_types | Description |
42	|-------|--------------|-------------|
43	| **Bug** | `build_error`, `test_failure`, `runtime_error`, `performance_issue`, `database_issue`, `security_issue`, `ui_bug`, `integration_issue`, `logic_error` | Defects and failures that were diagnosed and fixed |
44	| **Knowledge** | `best_practice`, `documentation_gap`, `workflow_issue`, `developer_experience`, `architecture_pattern`, `design_pattern`, `tooling_decision`, `convention` | Practices, patterns, conventions, decisions, workflow improvements, and documentation. Prefer the narrowest applicable value; `best_practice` is the fallback. |
45	
46	## Required Fields (both tracks)
47	
48	- **module**: Module or area affected
49	- **date**: ISO date in `YYYY-MM-DD`
50	- **problem_type**: One of the values listed in the Tracks table above
51	- **component**: One of the closed values in Classification Contract v2 above; `schema.yaml` is canonical.
52	- **severity**: One of `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`
53	
54	## Promotion Exit Fields
55	
56	Every **new or materially rewritten learning**, in either track, must include:
57	
58	- **source_refs**: A non-empty array of verifiable references that lets a later reader recover the evidence behind the learning. Prefer repo-relative source/test/doc paths, issue or PR identifiers, and other stable evidence references. Mechanical validation checks only that this is a non-empty array of non-empty strings; the author must judge whether the references are trustworthy and sufficient.
59	- **invalidation_condition**: A non-empty scalar or block string naming the concrete condition that requires the learning to be re-checked, revised, or retired. Mechanical validation checks only that content exists; the author must judge semantic adequacy.
60	
61	若条件依赖外部 issue、版本或依赖行为，写明哪个外部变化会使建议失效，以及 refresh 如何只读核查。移除 workaround、升级依赖再跑 CI 等修改后验证步骤写在正文，不能冒充已满足的外部条件。沿用 `invalidation_condition`，不并列增加同义退役字段；未改写的 legacy 文档不作批量迁移。
62	
63	Run `scripts/validate-frontmatter.py --promotion <doc-path>` after writing a new learning, materially rewriting an existing learning, or writing a replacement successor. Default validator mode remains parser-safety-only so untouched legacy docs are not forced through a bulk migration.
64	
65	## Bug Track Fields
66	
67	Required:
68	- **symptoms**: YAML array with 1-5 observable symptoms (errors, broken behavior)
69	- **root_cause**: One of `contract_drift`, `source_runtime_drift`, `stale_context`, `wrong_api`, `ownership_violation`, `concurrency`, `data_integrity`, `async_timing`, `memory_leak`, `config_error`, `logic_error`, `test_isolation`, `missing_validation`, `missing_permission`, `missing_workflow_step`, `inadequate_documentation`, `missing_tooling`, `incomplete_setup`
70	- **resolution_type**: One of `code_fix`, `migration`, `config_change`, `test_fix`, `dependency_update`, `environment_setup`, `workflow_improvement`, `documentation_update`, `tooling_addition`, `seed_data_update`
71	
72	## Knowledge Track Fields
73	
74	No additional track-specific required fields beyond the shared fields and the promotion exit fields. All fields below are optional:
75	
76	- **applies_when**: Conditions or situations where this guidance applies
77	- **symptoms**: Observable gaps or friction that prompted this guidance
78	- **root_cause**: Underlying cause, if there is a specific one
79	- **resolution_type**: Type of change, if applicable
80	
81	## Optional Fields (both tracks)
82	
83	- **related_components**: Other components involved
84	- **tags**: Search keywords, lowercase and hyphen-separated
85	
86	## Optional Fields (bug track only)
87	
88	- **framework_version**: Observed framework or runtime and version, for example `node 22.4.0`.
89	
90	## Backward Compatibility
91	
92	Docs created before the track system may have `symptoms`/`root_cause`/`resolution_type` on knowledge-type problem_types. These are valid legacy docs:
93	
94	- Bug-track fields present on a knowledge-track doc are harmless. Do not strip them during refresh unless the doc is being rewritten for other reasons.
95	- When creating **new** docs, follow the track rules above.
96	- Untouched legacy docs do not need promotion exit fields. A new learning, material rewrite, or replacement successor does.
97	
98	## Category Mapping
99	
100	- `build_error` -> `docs/solutions/build-errors/`
101	- `test_failure` -> `docs/solutions/test-failures/`
102	- `runtime_error` -> `docs/solutions/runtime-errors/`
103	- `performance_issue` -> `docs/solutions/performance-issues/`
104	- `database_issue` -> `docs/solutions/database-issues/`
105	- `security_issue` -> `docs/solutions/security-issues/`
106	- `ui_bug` -> `docs/solutions/ui-bugs/`
107	- `integration_issue` -> `docs/solutions/integration-issues/`
108	- `logic_error` -> `docs/solutions/logic-errors/`
109	- `developer_experience` -> `docs/solutions/developer-experience/`
110	- `workflow_issue` -> `docs/solutions/workflow-issues/`
111	- `best_practice` -> `docs/solutions/best-practices/`
112	- `documentation_gap` -> `docs/solutions/documentation-gaps/`
113	- `architecture_pattern` -> `docs/solutions/architecture-patterns/`
114	- `design_pattern` -> `docs/solutions/design-patterns/`
115	- `tooling_decision` -> `docs/solutions/tooling-decisions/`
116	- `convention` -> `docs/solutions/conventions/`
117	
118	## Validation Rules
119	
120	1. Determine the track from `problem_type` using the Tracks table.
121	2. All shared required fields must be present.
122	3. Bug-track required fields (`symptoms`, `root_cause`, `resolution_type`) must be present on bug-track docs.
123	4. Knowledge-track docs have no additional track-specific required fields beyond the shared and promotion exit fields.
124	5. New or materially rewritten learnings in either track must include non-empty `source_refs` and `invalidation_condition` promotion exit fields.
125	6. Bug-track fields on existing knowledge-track docs are harmless (see Backward Compatibility).
126	7. Enum fields must match the allowed values exactly.
127	8. Array fields must respect min/max item counts.
128	9. `date` must match `YYYY-MM-DD`.
129	10. `framework_version`, if present, names the observed framework/runtime and only applies to bug-track docs; legacy `rails_version` remains readable.
130	
131	## YAML Safety Rules
132	
133	Strict YAML 1.2 parsers (`yq`, `js-yaml` strict, PyYAML) reject array items
134	that start with a reserved indicator character as unquoted scalars. When
135	writing items for any array-of-strings field (`source_refs`, `symptoms`,
136	`applies_when`, `tags`, `related_components`, or any future array field), wrap the value in
137	double quotes if it starts with any of:
138	
139	`` ` ``, `[`, `*`, `&`, `!`, `|`, `>`, `%`, `@`, `?`
140	
141	Also quote if the value contains the substring `": "` — that punctuation
142	confuses flow-style parsers.
143	
144	Promotion exit strings must also be quoted when a common YAML parser could
145	implicitly type the plain token as a non-string value. This includes nulls,
146	booleans (`true`/`false` and the YAML 1.1 forms `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`), numeric
147	literals such as `0b1010` or `0x10`, sexagesimal values such as `1:20`, and
148	date/timestamp values such as `2026-07-20`. Quoting preserves the required
149	`array[string]` / `string` shape across `js-yaml` and PyYAML consumers.
150	
151	Example — before (breaks strict YAML):
152	
153	    symptoms:
154	      - `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache` does not restore in-container mDNS
155	
156	Example — after (parses cleanly):
157	
158	    symptoms:
159	      - "`sudo dscacheutil -flushcache` does not restore in-container mDNS"
160	
161	This rule applies to all array-of-strings frontmatter fields. Scalar string
162	fields like `description:` have their own quoting rules (see root
163	`AGENTS.md` under "YAML Frontmatter").

## Invocation Contract

For durable-learning or solution-documentation invocations, convert best-practice research into documentation enrichment: prevention guidance, authoritative citations, better terminology, clearer tradeoffs, and corrections to any overbroad lesson.
